rules.hero: character/appearance/(Role|Weapon|Pet)/Meshes/(Combat|Show); Combat and Show are separate assemblies.
rules.boss: character identity is the first segment; Role and Weapon merge; InCar is a separate state.
rules.mob: visual root ends before Role/Weapon/Meshes; SilverFish elemental roots share one logical id but remain separate visual assemblies.
rules.npc: Class_A and Class_S roots are complete characters; Class_B/C/D/BC are module libraries and are not summed into fabricated characters.
rules.animation: Distinct AnimSequence assets join only through exact skeletonPath.
rules.animation_histogram: Uses serialized animation_json.frameCount directly. Bins are 0–30, then 30-frame closed ranges through 600, plus >600; duration totals remain available per bin and assembly.
rules.texture: Mesh model_material targets join to material package_import targets that exactly match Texture assets.
rules.lod: Per-LOD values come from mesh_json.lods; effective values use the last available LOD for meshes with fewer LODs and always include coverage fields.
rules.bones: reference_bones_unique uses each included mesh's referenceBoneCount, deduplicated by skeletonPath; skeleton_asset_bones_unique reports full Skeleton asset rigs separately. active_bones_proxy is max(activeBoneCount) per unique skeleton and is not an exact active-bone-name union.

scopes.all: All ArtRes AnimSequence assets joined by skeletonPath.
scopes.core: Only joined AnimSequence assets whose path contains /ArtRes/AnimRes/.

output_files.precise_data.json: Metadata, logical characters, assembly summaries, assembly LOD rows, frame histograms, module-library summaries, and quality issues.
output_files.logical_characters.csv: One row per logical character; mutually exclusive assemblies remain listed rather than summed.
output_files.character_summary.csv: One row per concrete visual assembly.
output_files.character_lods.csv: Per-assembly, per-LOD triangle and bone fields with coverage/completeness flags.
output_files.character_animations.csv: Exact skeleton-linked animation clips with actual frame counts and durations.
output_files.character_textures.csv: Relation-linked unique textures and exact dimensions.
output_files.module_library_summary.csv: NPC module libraries kept separate from complete characters.
output_files.module_library_mesh_lods.csv: Per-mesh LOD data for NPC module libraries.
